title.zh: 授权菲律宾慈善彩票办公室在星期六下午举办带投注的赛马以用于慈善、救济与公益目的法案
title.en: An act to authorize the holding by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office of Horse Races, with betting, on Saturday Afternoons, for charitable, relief and civic purposes
title.orig: An act to authorize the holding by the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office of Horse Races, with betting, on Saturday Afternoons, for charitable, relief and civic purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 5 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1946/ra_79_1946.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provisions of existing laws to the contrary notwithstanding, the Board of Directors of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office is authorized to hold horse races, with betting, on such Saturday afternoons as it may determine for charitable, relief and civic purposes. Only native horses shall be allowed to run in any of these races.

All proceeds derived from these races, after deducting the prizes customarily set aside for horses winning first, second, and third places and their jockeys; the prizes for the owners of the winning horses; and the necessary administration expenses not to exceed ten per centum of the gross receipts, shall be apportioned and distributed by the Board of Directors of the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office to disabled veterans, war widows and orphans and to charitable, relief and civic organizations in such amounts and under such rules and regulations as may be approved by the President of the Philippines.
The racing club holding these races shall be exempt from the payment of any municipal or national tax.
The term "horses" when used in this Act shall be understood to refer to stallions and mares.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: October 21, 1946
